software_selection.basis: GitHub source-first hierarchy: no GitHub tags or releases; default-branch main commit at observation. CRAN is a related distribution and is not substituted.

workflow_selection.inventory_limit: Metadata-only get_dictionary is excluded consistently from the primary substantive acquisition workflow frame.

task.scope: Documented complete function defaults: unfiltered 2025 county PLACES data as returned; full requested query scope, not a bounded example. Full completeness requires independent evidence.
task.identity: 2025 named release plus separately captured publisher dataset revision and timestamp; release year is not necessarily survey year.

installation.pinning: Conditionally proposed immutable pin: remotes::install_github("brendensm/CDCPLACES@d35fe95a3170a1a3f840373e54a2ad4a992cc9a1"). Recommend classifying as environmental configuration, not a source patch; pending global human decision.
installation.dependencies: R >=4.1.0; curl, yyjsonr, tigris, sf, stats; system dependencies unverified

reference_strategy: Independent later capture of version-matched CDC 2025 county data and dictionary; compare independently selected keys and values, missingness, value type, geography and source/update identity after output lock. Assess completeness separately; no expected values prepared.
estimate: Proposed 4–8 human hours inclusive of preparation/review; unmeasured.
barriers: Dependency, full default query cost and endpoint availability not tested
Reference identity and API pagination unresolved
